meta.title: HSK 3.0 Level 2 — Chinese to English
meta.subtitle: 197 words · recall the meaning and pinyin
meta.desc: Shown the characters, recall the English meanings and the pinyin. The official HSK 3.0 Level 2 vocabulary as the standard now stands — the list announced at the end of 2025 and in force from 2026, not the 2021 list it replaced, which is a different and much longer one (500 words at Level 1 against 300). The official list has 200 rows, taking the cumulative total through this level to 500. Every card carries the simplified form, the traditional form, the syllabus's own pinyin, bopomofo, the measure word where the word takes one, and the official definition with its part of speech followed by the fuller range of English translations rather than a single gloss. Traditional characters are shown at half strength, and are omitted entirely where they are identical to the simplified — 89 of the 197 words. This deck has 197 cards rather than 200 because the syllabus lists a word again wherever it introduces a new sense, and a Folio card shows every sense a word has: 3 of this level's rows are words already carded in the Level 1 or Level 2 deck. Where the syllabus lists a word twice at the SAME level it has two readings to learn, and it gets one card showing both, with the definitions grouped under the reading they belong to. Word list, pinyin and definitions: the official HSK 3.0 vocabulary lists. Traditional forms, bopomofo, measure words and the additional senses: CC-CEDICT (CC BY-SA 4.0).
